description: INSTRUMENT VALIDATION, never an asset score. Can this eval detect a skill effect at all? Three unguided cases over examples/fixtures/skerry-codec, an invented frame protocol whose constants a model cannot know. The seeded defects are internally consistent violations of the protocol: each changes a value that encode and decode, or a conversion and its inverse, share, so the mutant round-trips and nothing in the code reveals it. A round-trip-only suite catches none of them and a suite built from the protocol's own vectors catches all of them, both checked before any model was run. No rule appears in a comment, a prompt or a file name, and the answer key is withheld from the workspace. The skill under test carries the constants. The no-skill frontier control is calibrated first. Activation is not asserted, so the composite is quality only; routing is read from the traces.
